obsah:
We spent the weekend of 20–21 May on the bike again, but this time in nice weather that accompanied us on our long journeys. On Saturday the traditional Pražské služby event took place in Malešice, where Vlasta and Michal Budský rode together with parkour athletes and freestyle guys. The first show was by the ramp and the second right in front of the main stage. Besides the adrenaline on bikes, we got some traffic adrenaline as a bonus. Mini cars for teenage drivers were being tested at the event, driving near our obstacles, and while we were setting up, one of the cars crashed into the obstacles and pushed them together just as Vlasta was between them. Luckily the driver slammed on the brakes, so only the car's lights suffered and Vlasta went to change his underwear. 

After the event in Malešice, Vlasta shot off without Michal to Strupčice and its luxurious swimming pool complex. Who would have thought such a small village could have such a nice sports complex. The whole event, headed by Martin Šimůnek, was a bit more intimate than the others but superbly prepared. We stretched it out a bit with competitions for the spectators and rewarded young bikers with signed cards.

Sunday was all about a trip to Wallachia, where one of the world's largest chip manufacturers was celebrating. Unfortunately the professionally prepared event was disrupted at the end by an approaching storm. Luckily improvisation is our domain, and right after arriving Vlasta and Michal prepared a backup option under a tent instead of the outdoor show. It looked as if it would be unnecessary, but in the end it really did rain and we rode mainly under the tent. At the end there was some egging on, and a jump from the trailer over a new Škoda Enyaq was prepared. In the wet it was a bit close to the windscreen, but in the end even a double attempt worked out 🙂

During the week we rode a few individual training sessions and checked the route for the camps, so there was plenty of fun.
